| description = Cordelia is a member of the worldwide bard faction. Due to her position in the world, relative isolation and ability to be solo-pulled, Cordelia is frequently camped by players. Thought should be taken with regards to the faction hits as she also includes [[Guards of Qeynos]] and the [[Knights of Truth]]; these factions could affect possible quest options and banking opportunities. Maximum money drop 2 platinum, 9 gold, 9 silver and 9 copper
=== Pathing ===

Cordelia spawns at the spires near South Karana, but she is a pathing mob, meaning that if you're certain she is not being camped already and you do not find her at the spires near South Karana, then she is en route. 10 minutes after spawning, she will walk north along the path, towards the gypsy camp at 6. Moving north to the crossroads she will take a left heading west. Her resting spot is 1 on the map, just outside of the steps between the trees. She will stay here for approximately 10 mins if still alive and continue on back to the wizard spires. (she walks a straight line back).  She will take roughly 33 minutes to make a loop of spawning, waiting at spawn location, running north along the path, waiting at the house on spot 1 on the map, and coming back to where she spawned.

=== Experience Gains ===

Iksar Necromancer Blue
* 55 kills from 25 to 26
* 58 kills from 26 to 27
